primary_frontend_metric: all-pair mutual count AP separately for each detector
shared_data_warning: Three detectors share images and labels and are not independent replications
reference_validation: Four order/direction hypotheses on the same saved ORB fixed mutual correspondences, without trajectory error; require residual separation; metric scale remains separate

rolling_alignment.minimum_geometry: rank at least 2 with positive source variance
rolling_alignment.uncertainty: paired segment block bootstrap; no independent-sequence inference

vertex_resampling.rule: sample vertex blocks with replacement, retain unique sampled vertices and induced pairs; report as sensitivity rather than assert calibrated coverage

detector_controls: Record all getter parameters; raw thresholds selected using feature-count targets only before pair/trajectory outcome evaluation
claims: No correlation test on nine configurations; remove acceptance-error abstract claim if full sweeps fail to support it; no metric-scale claim from convention validation
